# Town of Pittsfield municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 18; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Article 1 -- the outgoing moderator, George Deblon, declined, and Ian Sullivan was elected Moderator for a one-year term. This Ian Sullivan is a Pittsfield (Windsor County) town officer and is not Rutland County State's Attorney Ian Sullivan

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Joyce Stevens and AJ Ruben as Pittsfield selectboard members and styles Ann Kuendig 'Select Board Secretary'; she is a member of the board -- 'Secretary' is a board role

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Joyce Stevens was re-elected to the Selectboard for a three-year term
Town of Pittsfield, Elected Officials page (pittsfieldvt.com): lists Ann Kuendig, AJ Ruben, and Joyce Stevens as the town's selectboard members

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Tricia Abbondelo was elected Town Clerk for a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Tricia Abbondelo as Pittsfield's Town Clerk

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Tricia Abbondelo was elected Town Treasurer for a three-year term, in a separate article from the clerkship
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Tricia Abbondelo as Pittsfield's Town Treasurer

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Jennifer Wall Howard was elected Lister for a three-year term and Jonathan Colton was elected Lister for a one-year term
Town of Pittsfield, Elected Officials page (pittsfieldvt.com): lists listers Jonathan Colton, Jeremy Rayner, and Jennifer Howard
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three auditors on staggered three-year terms

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Anne Muller was elected Auditor for a three-year term

Town of Pittsfield, Elected Officials page (pittsfieldvt.com): lists auditors Kadimik (printed 'Kadamik'), Beth Stanton, and Ann Muller; the fuller forms from the minutes and the certified justice of the peace listing (Candace Kadimik, Mary Elizabeth Stanton, Anne Muller) are used for the person records

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns that hold trust funds elect trustees of public funds

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Henry Hotchkiss was elected Trustee of Public Funds for a three-year term. One three-year seat stands each year, so the board has three seats; the other two holders are published in no current official source, so those seats are created without memberships
Town of Pittsfield, Cemetery Commission page (pittsfieldvt.com): lists five commissioners -- Chuck Colton, Steve Martin, George Deblon, Connie Martin, and Martha Beyersdorf

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Martha Beyersdorf and George Deblon were elected Cemetery Commissioners for three-year terms (the draft minutes print 'Marth Beyersdorf'; the commission page and the town's 2015 records spell Martha)
Roger Clark Memorial Library, Trustees page (on the town website, pittsfieldvt.com): lists five trustees -- Micheline Bissell, Doreen Morin, Amanda Barrett, Cynthia Bryant, and Katrina Hotchkiss

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Katrina Hotchkiss was elected a Roger Clark Memorial Library Trustee for a three-year term

Town of Pittsfield, Draft Minutes of the Annual Pittsfield Town and School Meeting, Tuesday, March 3, 2026 (posted on the town's town meeting page; DRAFT minutes -- the town's official posted record of the meeting): Doug Mianulli was elected Second Constable for a two-year term. Pittsfield's 2026 warning elected a Second Constable only; the town elects no First Constable, so no first-constable post is created
